risks.risk: Two qualifying bank references are not evidenced; the current answer does not establish comparable delivery within the last five years. This qualification gap could make the tender ineligible.
risks.mitigation: Provide two reference descriptions with customer identity, comparable scope and delivery dates, or confirm that the requirement cannot be met.

risks.risk: Financial capacity for a contract of this size has not been confirmed from the available accounts and revenue information.
risks.mitigation: Have the financial or commercial specialist assess the available evidence against the qualification requirement and confirm whether it is sufficient.

risks.risk: Tender signature authority, six-month validity and any reservations or deviations remain unconfirmed; unresolved items could invalidate the tender or leave material deviations undisclosed.
risks.mitigation: Obtain authorised sign-off, confirm the validity period, and approve a separate list of all reservations or deviations before submission.

risks.risk: The offered service does not yet demonstrate synchronized balances and transactions across all customer and adviser channels within the required two seconds.
risks.mitigation: Confirm end-to-end channel synchronization and agree the measurement method, start and end points, and applicable performance percentile.

risks.risk: The PSD3/PSR readiness response names a programme but does not describe its preparation steps, while delivery is stated to follow once final rules apply.
risks.mitigation: Describe the readiness activities and how regulatory changes will be assessed and incorporated; clarify the commitment and timing basis.

risks.risk: Support for the bank's specific SME accounting platforms is unconfirmed; available ready-made connectors cover only selected Nordic platforms.
risks.mitigation: Identify the bank's target platforms, confirm existing connector coverage and define any additional integration work.

risks.risk: Data lineage onward from the platform into the bank's reporting tools is not included, leaving the requested source-to-report lineage incomplete.
risks.mitigation: Clarify the reporting-tool boundary and agree whether additional lineage capability or integration work is required.

risks.risk: Python notebooks are only on the roadmap for 2027, so analysts may not initially be able to use their own Python tools on governed data as requested.
risks.mitigation: Confirm availability and timing of Python notebooks and agree how analyst needs will be supported in the interim.

risks.risk: The AI response does not separately specify data used, explanation methods and human review points for each AI function, including the data-quality assistant and adviser summary.
risks.mitigation: Document the data, explainability approach and human review or approval point for every AI function.

risks.risk: The EU AI Act response covers risk classification but does not describe broader support for the bank's obligations.
risks.mitigation: Clarify the documentation and other support provided for the bank's AI Act obligations and identify any boundaries.

risks.risk: Standard support access can occur from outside the EU/EEA; EU/EEA-only access is a paid option and is not confirmed in the offered service. This conflicts with the stated data-location requirement.
risks.mitigation: Confirm EU/EEA-only access for all support scenarios in the offered service, or clearly state the deviation and its commercial treatment.

risks.risk: The exit plan and open-format export are stated, but the plan is not confirmed to enable transfer to another supplier or back in-house.
risks.mitigation: Describe the exit activities and demonstrate how they support transfer to another supplier or in-house operation.

risks.risk: The required 99.95% monthly availability is only available as a paid premium option, and neither its inclusion nor the maintenance-window measurement basis is confirmed.
risks.mitigation: Confirm whether the required target and measurement basis will be included in the offer, and state the associated commercial treatment.

risks.risk: The standard maintenance window is 00:00–04:00 rather than the required 01:00–05:00; no agreement to use the required window is evidenced.
risks.mitigation: Confirm use of the 01:00–05:00 window or explicitly record the deviation for evaluation.

risks.risk: Critical-incident support is 24/7 in English, but Norwegian-language support is limited to weekdays 08:00–16:00.
risks.mitigation: Confirm 24/7 critical-incident support in both English and Norwegian, or clearly state the service deviation.

risks.risk: The phased plan does not establish that every phase delivers value and is independently usable, as required; this could undermine the bank's no-big-bang transition constraint.
risks.mitigation: For every phase, state the value delivered and how it can be used independently, and confirm the plan avoids a big-bang replacement.

risks.risk: The proposed first phase is described as low risk and offering early value, but is not shown to be the highest-value, lowest-risk area or supported by the requested rationale.
risks.mitigation: Compare candidate starting areas by value and risk, explain the selection rationale and validate it with the bank.

risks.risk: Key delivery personnel and their relevant experience have not been named or described, weakening the delivery plan evidence.
risks.mitigation: Name at least the project manager and solution architect and provide their relevant experience.

risks.risk: The required price form and cost coverage, milestone-linked payment model and acceptance of the bank's audit right remain unconfirmed; Appendix C and the draft contract are also absent from the provided tender documents.
risks.mitigation: Obtain Appendix C and Appendix D, complete and review the price response, confirm milestone-payment availability, and obtain a decision on the audit right.

risks.risk: API log retention of at least five years and coverage of every API call have not been explicitly confirmed, despite the stated configurable retention capability.
risks.mitigation: Confirm that all API calls are covered and that logs will be retained for at least five years in the offered service.

scope: Account services for retail and business deposit accounts, product rules, account lifecycle, joint accounts, authorised users and account or amount blocking.
Real-time account information, event streams, parallel running with the current core system and daily balance reconciliation.
Documented REST APIs, consent-based third-party access, partner sandbox and data services, including regulatory reporting and data quality.
Phased migration of accounts and history, with test migrations, reconciliation and fallback; service operation and support.
assumptions: The proposed transition is phased and uses parallel running with the current core system; phase sequencing and acceptance evidence remain to be agreed.
The bank will provide the roles and capacity by phase described in the response; delivery pace may be constrained by the bank's approximately 35-person IT team.
Hosting and backups are in Norway and Finland; standard third-line support access can be from outside the EU/EEA unless the EU/EEA-only option is agreed.
The 99.95% availability target is a paid premium option, and the standard maintenance window is 00:00–04:00.
open_items: Confirm qualifying bank references, financial capacity, authorised tender signature, six-month validity and the approved deviations list.
Confirm all support access can remain within the EU/EEA and resolve the availability target, measurement basis, maintenance window and 24/7 Norwegian support gap.
Complete the AI-function disclosures, confirm API log retention, and clarify PSD3/PSR preparation and broader EU AI Act support.
Confirm channel synchronization against the two-second requirement, SME accounting-platform coverage, reporting-tool lineage and Python notebook availability.
Define value and standalone usability for every delivery phase; name the project manager and solution architect and describe their experience.
Obtain Appendix C and Appendix D; confirm pricing scope, milestone-linked payments and acceptance of the bank's audit right.
Clarify transaction and peak volumes, migration volumes and history period, regulatory report set and formats, and the boundary of EU/EEA support-access requirements.

go_no_go_facts: The two-bank-reference qualification requirement is not yet evidenced, and the available financial information has not been confirmed as sufficient.
Several material shall-requirement gaps remain, particularly EU/EEA support access, 99.95% availability, maintenance timing and 24/7 Norwegian critical-incident support.

The complete commercial and contract response is not established: prices and cost coverage, milestone payments and audit acceptance remain open, and the referenced price form and draft contract were not provided.
